QuestInfo.name: Schegerazade's First Riddle
QuestInfo.0: Schegerazade is full of stories about the palace. She is smart and pretty. Listen to what she has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Schegerazade promised Alpha and Beta a prize for answering three riddles. The first: What was the most #bprecious thing in the desert#k? Too easy! Life in the desert was impossible without... #rthis#k.
QuestInfo.2: The answer to Schegerazade's first question was water. Water was the most precious thing in the desert. Too easy!
